# Key Shift London

> South London youth-development Community Interest Company (ages 11–18). We train and equip the adults around young people — parents, mentors, coaches, pastoral leads and organisations — and give them the tools to track real progress. Free to start. CIC registration 15685849.

Key Shift London (KSL) delivers intentional, measurable youth development through "Precision Work": the SHAPE model (identity), the PILLAR framework (practitioner readiness), and the Precision Streamline System. It serves schools, PRUs, alternative provision, sports academies, councils, charities and community organisations. Tagline: "Shaping with precision. Unlocking for purpose."

## Core pages
- [Our Approach](https://keyshiftlondon.org/approach.html): The SHAPE model, provision vs precision, the PILLAR framework and the Precision Streamline System.
- [Precision Training](https://keyshiftlondon.org/training.html): Self-paced practitioner training. Level 1 is free; Level 2 is £34.99.
- [PRE:CORD](https://keyshiftlondon.org/precord.html): The youth-development platform connecting young people, mentors, organisations and commissioners — record sessions, track progress, report impact. 30-day free trial.
- [For Organisations](https://keyshiftlondon.org/organisations.html): Train your team and track outcomes on PRE:CORD; book a scoping call.
- [FAQ](https://keyshiftlondon.org/faq.html): Common questions about KSL, training and PRE:CORD.

## Free tools
- [The Breakthrough Blueprint](https://keyshiftlondon.org/blueprint): A free tool for the young people you can't reach.
- [PILLAR Diagnostic](https://keyshiftlondon.org/pillar-diagnostic.html): A free 30-question practitioner identity assessment across six pillars.

## Guides
- [The SHAPE Model](https://keyshiftlondon.org/guides/the-shape-model.html): A framework for youth identity.
- [How to Become a Youth Mentor in the UK](https://keyshiftlondon.org/guides/how-to-become-a-youth-mentor.html): A practical guide.
